corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 4th-order vowel stroke (ራ), forming the standard Amharic imperfect plural ይቀራሉ ('they will remain/stay away').
Both legs of the first Fidel are of equal length (1st-order በ), forming the preposition + noun በዙርያው ('around it').
The 2nd-order plural suffix stroke on ሡ is visible on the right leg of the character, matching the canonical Ge'ez plural verb ወዘአግኀሡ and its Amharic gloss ያነሡት in line 32.
The initial character is a narrow ለ, forming the standard Amharic Andemta gloss ለብቻው for Ge'ez በባሕቲቱ (as in Column 1, Line 20).
